1. Engagement Scope

This compliance review focuses on wage and hour practices for Nolan Pearce Consulting's non-exempt workforce in 21 states. The assessment included a statistical analysis of timekeeping records for 249 employees and a review of meal and rest period policies and administration.

2. Methodology

A "desk audit" methodology was employed, consisting of a review of policies, procedures, and a sample of 249 transactional records provided by Nolan Pearce Consulting. No on-site fieldwork or employee interviews were conducted as part of this limited-scope engagement.

4. Detailed Findings
AAR-6666-001INFORMATIONALMONITORING
Observation

WARN Act notification timeline not met for 249 affected employees in 21 reduction-in-force

Corrective Action Required

A senior executive will be formally designated at each company establishment to be responsible for the review and certification of the annual OSHA 300A summary.

Management Response

Management has performed a cost-benefit analysis and determined that the cost of full remediation exceeds the potential risk exposure. We have implemented mitigating controls and formally accepted the residual risk.

Owner: Vice President of Data & Analytics • Due: 2011-03-28
AAR-7203-002INFORMATIONALOPEN
Observation

OFCCP affirmative action plan goals not updated for the current plan year

Corrective Action Required

A quarterly self-audit of I-9 forms for all new hires will be instituted, with results reported to the Chief Compliance Officer.

Management Response

Management has performed a cost-benefit analysis and determined that the cost of full remediation exceeds the potential risk exposure. We have implemented mitigating controls and formally accepted the residual risk.

Owner: Quality Assurance Specialist • Due: 2011-03-28
AAR-9480-003MEDIUMDEFERRED
Observation

HIPAA privacy notice not provided to 249 new enrollees in the group health plan

Corrective Action Required

All 10b5-1 trading plans for Section 16 officers must be reviewed and pre-cleared by the General Counsel to ensure compliance with all current SEC requirements, including cooling-off periods.

Management Response

Management concurs with the finding and has already initiated corrective action independent of this review. The designated owner will provide written confirmation of full remediation no later than the due date specified above.

Owner: Senior Analyst, Market Intelligence • Due: 2011-05-28
AAR-1160-004LOWDEFERRED
Observation

Overtime eligibility misclassification affecting 249 employees in applicable job families

Corrective Action Required

Revise the employee handbook to remove language that could be interpreted as restricting employees' Section 7 rights under the NLRA. Submit revised handbook to labor counsel for review within 60 days.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue is part of a larger, previously identified process deficiency that is being addressed through a company-wide transformation project (Project Serenade). We request this finding be tracked as part of that larger initiative.

Owner: Director of ESG & Sustainability • Due: 2011-05-28
AAR-6456-005LOWMONITORING
Observation

Annual merit increase administration varied by >16% across comparable job families

Corrective Action Required

The designated management official at each of the 21 establishments shall personally certify the OSHA 300A summary by the February 1st deadline annually.

Management Response

This finding has been remediated as of the report date. Supporting documentation, including revised policy language and employee acknowledgment records, has been provided to ACPWB under separate cover. Nolan Pearce Consulting requests formal closure of this item.

Owner: Manager of Sustainability Programs • Due: 2011-06-28
